objectives.intro: Break up the shake-down outside the Lucky Spoon.
objectives.find_mara: Find Mara at Quinn Garage on Brickrow Lane (east of Kettle Street).
objectives.chain_dogs: Find Duke Brannigan in the Chain Lot, east end of Brickrow Lane.
objectives.market: Track Eli's satchel east through the Canal Market.
objectives.pikes: Get Eli's satchel from the Pike sisters at Pier Square.
objectives.ironworks: Find Gus Pereira at the Ironworks. Try Switch House 4 on the Rail Spur.
objectives.foundry: Take Otto Kragg's payroll book from the Foundry Floor.
objectives.neon: Search the Starlight Arcade on the Neon Mile for the money room.
objectives.rooftops: Chase Jett Vance up the fire escape to the rooftops.
objectives.return_home: Hurry back to Quinn Garage. Something's wrong!
objectives.floodgate: Meet Jett's crew at Floodgate Bridge, past the Neon Mile rooftops.
objectives.dockgate: Break through the Greyline gate at Dockside.
objectives.rook: Stop Victor Rook on the warehouse floor.
objectives.epilogue: Bellwether is safe. Finish side jobs, try the Alley Cat Cup, enjoy the neighborhood.

details.intro: Chain Dogs are leaning on Dot. Punch, kick, jump, guard.
details.find_mara: Dot says Eli has been missing for four days. Mara has been searching for him. Walk east out of Kettle Street.
details.chain_dogs: Eli's note: 'If I don't come back, the Chain Dogs know where the book went.' Eat at the diner and learn a technique at Benny's first if you like.
details.market: Duke sold Eli's satchel to the Pike sisters, fences at the Canal Market. The River Line buses are running again.
details.pikes: Jett Vance, a hotshot from the Neon Mile, is also after the satchel. The Pike sisters work Pier Square, east of the Canal Walk.
details.ironworks: Eli's manifests show envelopes to Switch House 4, signed 'V.R.' The polaroid shows Eli with switchman Gus Pereira.
details.foundry: Gus says Greyline Development pays Otto's crew to wreck rail-side homes. The payroll book in the foundry office is proof.
details.neon: Otto named Victor Rook, Greyline's fixer, and said the Starlight Arcade counts the cash in its back room.
details.rooftops: Jett grabbed the count book and ran up the fire escape at the east end of Arcade Alley.
details.return_home: Teddy says Mara called: something's wrong at the garage. The rail tunnel on the Rail Spur leads straight to Brickrow Lane, or take a bus.
details.floodgate: Gray Jackets wrecked the garage, but Mara kept copies. Eli's tape says Rook is holding him in the Floodgate warehouse.
details.dockgate: Officer Price needs Rook's original ledger to make arrests. Captain Holt guards the gate.
details.warehouse: Holt said Eli is in the holding office past the storage floor, and Rook keeps the ledger on him.
details.rook: Eli and Mara are cracking Rook's safe. Rook waits on the main floor.
details.epilogue: Thanks for playing! Everyone is back in their old spots. The Alley Cat Cup can be replayed for cash.

notes.eli_missing: Eli has been missing four days. He came into the diner Thursday with a notebook, scared.
notes.eli_note: Eli's note to Mara: 'If I don't come back, the Chain Dogs know where the book went.'
notes.gray_coat: A man in a gray coat paid the Chain Dogs to scare Kettle Street and grab Eli's bag.
notes.satchel: The satchel held route sheets: envelopes to Switch House 4 signed 'V.R.', and a photo of Eli with Gus Pereira.
notes.greyline: Greyline Development pays gangs to frighten people out of homes it wants to buy.
notes.rook_name: Victor Rook is Greyline's fixer. He trained Nico and Eli as kids at Benny's.
notes.count_book: The Starlight count book lists payments to every gang, in Rook's handwriting.
notes.setback: Gray Jackets stole the evidence, but Mara photocopied everything.
notes.cassette: Eli's tape: 'If they take me, it's the Floodgate warehouse.'
notes.ledger_needed: Officer Price needs Rook's ORIGINAL ledger. Copies won't stick in court.
notes.eli_truth: Eli took delivery work from Rook to pay his mom's hospital bills, then copied the ledger to expose him.
notes.ending: Rook was arrested. Greyline's permits were revoked.
